findings.location: Body, first paragraph: phrase "mirror-convention Jones value $-t^4+t^3+t$".
findings.evidence: The assigned two-strand example computes t+t^3-t^4 for the right-handed trefoil in the fixed Jones convention. Its mirror has value t^(-1)+t^(-3)-t^(-4). Replace the mirror-convention description with the right-handed trefoil value. B-page prose is outside reader edit authority.

findings.location: Body, final sentence: "any normalization whose parameters fail ... distinguishes the two Markov stabilizations".
findings.evidence: Failure of a normalization relation need not distinguish the two stabilized values. Choose alpha=-(uz)^(-1) in the assigned coefficient ring. Both stabilization factors equal -1, while the original value on 1 in B_1 is 1. Thus both stabilizations can agree while violating invariance. Replace the assertion with failure of invariance under at least one stabilization. B-page prose is outside reader edit authority.
